{{Quote|There are skirmishes in Wild Space, riots on Quesh... Galactic War is imminent. We can no longer afford neutrality.|Lana Beniko|<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />}}
Following the [[Order of Zildrog]] [[Order of Zildrog campaign|crisis]], '''skirmishes''' occurred in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] involving forces of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Lana Beniko]] later mentioned them while [[Gender/Legends|she]] was discussing the future of the [[Eternal Alliance]] with [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]], the organization's leader.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />
